Container.Name: MyDay
Container.Overview: Personal daily dashboard: to-do list, habit tracker with heatmap, calendar, hashtag notes, mood & energy check-in, 789 ml water bottles, a three-a-day photo journal and a countdown card. Data lives in a single JSON file on your array and syncs to every device you sign in from.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port to open the dashboard on. Point your browser at http://TOWER-IP:8585

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Folder on the array that holds state.json — your entire dashboard. Back this up.

Config.Name: Username
Config.Description: The username you sign in with.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: The password you sign in with. Set this — without it the dashboard has no login at all. You only sign in once per device.

Config.Name: Stay signed in (days)
Config.Description: How long a device stays signed in before it asks again.

Config.Name: Secure cookie
Config.Description: Leave false for plain http:// on your LAN. Set to true only if you reach the dashboard through an HTTPS reverse proxy, otherwise the login cookie will be rejected.
